item.title: Version 0.4.1
item.description:
Search, fast and complete

  • Typing is instant — even with filters and names, results keep up with your keystrokes.
  • Every match is reachable — results load as you scroll, all the way back to your oldest messages.
  • Sort either direction — a small arrow beside the Aa control flips newest-first and oldest-first.

item.title: Version 0.4.0
item.description:
AI search, rebuilt

  • New on-device engine — a tiny local router plus real conversation retrieval. No gigabyte model download, near-instant answers, fully offline.
  • Distinct moments — results now come from different exchanges, and each one expands to show the conversation around it.
  • Date queries use your local timezone; group-scoped questions actually scope to the group.

Sharing

  • Share cards — leaderboard rows share a branded card with the person's photo and your message counts, pre-addressed to the person it's about.

Polish

  • Smoother scrolling on Nostalgia and Vernacular.
  • Vernacular vocabulary in three readable columns.
  • Fixed phantom "left the chat" events and cold-launch stat mismatches.

item.title: Version 0.3.1
item.description:
Dashboard

  • Chat history at a glance — every conversation row carries its message-frequency curve, all sharing one timeline of your texting life.
  • ⌘+ / ⌘− / ⌘0 — zoom the dashboard like a browser.
  • Open any memory in Messages — quoted messages in the chat timelines are clickable and jump straight to that message in Messages.app.

Vernacular

  • Clearer names: Sentence frames, Words, and Expressions; tabs are now Circles and Vocabulary with an honest loading state.
  • Everyone in the word-spread graph is labeled, and per-person profiles say when they're still loading.

Other

  • Removed the hide-suggestions prompt — one tap in Manage hides anyone permanently.
  • Reveal-in-Messages is deep-link only — all keyboard/Accessibility automation of Messages was removed.

item.title: Version 0.3.0
item.description:
Dashboard

  • New paginated dashboard — Overview, Vernacular, Nostalgia, and Social Graph pages.
  • Vernacular: your idiolect, mined entirely on-device — distinctive words, reclaimed words (normal English you made your own), signature sentence frames, slang-bearing phrases, and a word-spread graph showing who you traded vocabulary with. Click anyone for their vocabulary profile.
  • Nostalgia: per-chat memory timelines — first messages, notable moments, rekindle nudges.

AI search

  • New on-device model (Qwen3-4B), far more reliable tool-calling, scoped person questions, big speedups.

Performance & fixes

  • Streaming loaders cut peak memory from ~12 GB to under 2 GB; smooth scrolling throughout.
  • Double-clicking a search result now brings Messages to the front.

item.title: Version 0.2.1
item.description:
Dashboard timeline slider

  • Drag anywhere on the bar to slide the brushed window. Previously only the colored pill itself was draggable; the dim sides were inert. Now the whole strip responds to drag-to-translate.
  • Added a center grip indicator (three dots) on the pill so it's visually obvious it's draggable.

item.title: Version 0.2.0
item.description:
Search

  • from:me and from:"<your name/phone>" match your sent messages (AddressBook "Me" record auto-detected).
  • chat:"A, B, C" matches a group with EXACTLY those participants — the unnamed-group case Messages.app renders as a comma list.
  • with:"A, B, C" splits commas and AND's the participants — the loose-superset variant.

Dashboard

  • Timeline slider: fixed drag-past-swap regression and now shows the year on both bounds.

Updates

  • Sparkle 2.x wired in — Check for Updates… in the menu bar.
